div.div:
Entity or editor?
If an operation is driven by state the project cannot see — what is on
disk, what the workspace's palette says, what a render just produced —
it belongs on the editor. If it is a question the project answers about
itself, it stays a const query on the entity.
That is why sanitize(), mergeFileScan() and applyProcessingResults()
live on ProjectEditor while detectStaleness() stays on ProjectItem.

div.div:
Presets are provenance, not a flag
An output preset is an ordinary OutputProfile the library defines in
code (models/output_presets.hpp). There is no 'is a preset' field: a
profile is a preset because it came from the catalogue. Presets are
never serialised — the serializer strips them on save and drops
copies on load — so outputProfileId can reference one by stable id.
